literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) reports a FLAG tag knocked into the Fam209 locus at the stop codon, placing the tag after the last residue (171). The authoritative topology landmarks assign residues 74–171 to the intracellular compartment, so this C-terminal FLAG is cytoplasmic, not extracellular. FAM209A has only one extracellular region (residues 20–59, between the cleaved signal peptide and the single TM helix), but no ledger line reports any tag insertion there or at the mature N-terminus (residue 20). Because every qualifying site must be grounded in a ledger line, and no ledger line supports an extracellular insertion, the surface-tag site list is empty.

literature_other_positions.note: FLAG tag knocked in at the stop codon (after residue 171, the last residue S) in full-length Fam209-FLAG mice; the C-terminus is intracellular (topology: 74–171 intracellular), so this is a cytoplasmic tag, not a surface tag.
